blocks.text: What you need to know about plague Speculation over the death in a Russian plague laboratory Following the death of a Russian laboratory worker, there is speculation about an outbreak of pneumonic plague, a highly contagious bacterial infection of the lungs. Russia denies there is a broader risk to the community. Russian officials have said the laboratory worker’s death was not caused by a plague pathogen. The 28-year-old died of “pneumonia of unknown origin,” according to Russia’s Interfax news agency, citing Rospotrebnadzor, Russia’s disease-control agency.
